title.narrative: Award for Roma Integration in the Western Balkans and Turkey 2023

description.narrative: This action will enable the fifth edition of the EU Roma Integration Award in the Western Balkans and Turkey. The focus of the 2023 award will be the green economy and digital agenda, which are key areas for the future approaches in improving the position of vulnerable Roma women and men in the region.
